Dutch commentator Eva Vlaardingerbroek speaks with Tucker Carlson after Britain barred her entry. Carlson reads her the official letter on air. Her visa was canceled with no right to appeal.

The letter says her presence would not serve the public good. Carlson expresses shock that a Dutch journalist got such treatment. She describes the ban as punishment for her views. The pair frame the case as a free speech test for the West. The episode gives her side in full, with the letter's own words as proof. She answers with defiance, not apology.
